title: Craft & Code
description: A series on what happens when designers build — the decisions, the tradeoffs, and the things you only learn on both sides of the handoff.

title: Building Careeredge(AI, Design & Code)
description:
This is an ongoing series on the architectural, experience and system design work I did for Careeredged.
I will walk you through my thinking and how i arrived at several decisions that made this a usable, delightful and scalable AI integrated system.
